text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturady. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Car bomb kills 10 and wounds 68 in Algiers on Thursday.
- Several houses were damaged in Hussein Dey suburb in Algiers where a car bomb exploded on Thursday.
- World bank loans to Algeria totalled $428 million in 1996.
- Government and workers' union representatives assess the social situation ahead of a meeting between government, union and business officials.
- The Social and Economic National Council meets on Sunday to discuss the economy.
- World Bank official hails Algeria's reform stabilisation programme after a visit to Algiers.
